settings.masks: Saved reviewed masks, necessary for stable person colors across cuts. Automatic guide rejected during QA because IDs change within shots.

mode_behavior.manual_enhanced_depth_off: Stable per-character 20% identity tints from reviewed masks, with explicit reference mapping and reviewed positions/absences.
mode_behavior.easy_enhanced_depth_off: Shared cyan 20%; timestamp/position identity anchors and original visible person fallback where tint is missing.
mode_behavior.enhanced_off: Original footage; coordinate and reviewed assignment guidance; no color claims.
mode_behavior.depth: Describe actual depth signal. Only full-strength reviewed multi-person depth supports identity hues; translucent depth keeps shared-depth positional guidance.
mode_behavior.face_mesh: Conditional guidance only when mesh is enabled.
mode_behavior.audio: Original/pitched/silent instructions follow the job snapshot.

limitations: Successful comparison used saved manual matches; initial automatic identity-color guide was rejected during QA.
Not an isolated color-only comparison because reviewed masks differ from automatic shared-cyan baseline.
One unseeded clip does not prove generalization.
